corrections.reason: The printed glyphs are clearly 'ኅሊና' (mind/contemplation, paired with 'ተመስጦ'), where 'ኅ' and 'ና' were visually misread as 'ከ' and 'ህ'.
The 3rd-order vowel ring on the right leg of 'ፊ' is visible in the image and required by the Amharic word 'የፊተኛውን' ('the former/preceding one').
Translating the Ge'ez root 'ወሰገዱ ሎቱ', the printed Amharic verb is clearly 'ሰገዱለት' ('they bowed down to Him'), with 1st-order 'ሰ', 'ገ', and 2nd-order 'ዱ'.
The final word on the line is 'ዓመት' ('በሰባት መንፈቀ ዓመት' - in seven half-years / periods), which is a complete word and does not wrap mid-word into 'ፈጽሞ' on the next page.
